The rate limiter module is `src/lib/rate-limit.ts`. Nine source files import from it, all `consumeRateLimit`, and one test file imports the full set, including `resetRateLimits`, which is only used there.

- `src/app/api/webhooks/inbound/route.ts`
- `src/server/services/auth-service.ts`
- `src/server/services/comment-service.ts`
- `src/server/services/invitation-service.ts`
- `src/server/services/search-service.ts`
- `src/actions/auth/login.ts`
- `src/actions/auth/reset-password.ts`
- `src/actions/comments/create-comment.ts`
- `src/actions/members/invite-member.ts`
- `tests/lib/rate-limit.test.ts` imports `RATE_LIMIT_BUCKETS`, `consumeRateLimit`, `getBucketConfig`, `resetRateLimits` and `setOrgPlan`.

Four test files (`tests/services/comment-service.test.ts`, `invitation-service.test.ts`, `search-service.test.ts` and `tests/server/plan-limits.test.ts`) only reference `@/lib/rate-limit` in `vi.mock` calls, which replace the module with a double and don't import from it, so I left them out. `tests/server/_support/doubles/misc.ts` defines that double and also doesn't import the real module. The `scripts/` and `corpus-manifest.json` hits are metadata that describe the module, not imports.

ANSWER: src/app/api/webhooks/inbound/route.ts, src/server/services/auth-service.ts, src/server/services/comment-service.ts, src/server/services/invitation-service.ts, src/server/services/search-service.ts, src/actions/auth/login.ts, src/actions/auth/reset-password.ts, src/actions/comments/create-comment.ts, src/actions/members/invite-member.ts, tests/lib/rate-limit.test.ts
